text: You borrowed eight lakh rupees from {victim} and can't pay it back. {victim} had started humiliating you about it in front of people.
gossip: {self} owed {victim} a lot of money, and {victim} kept making a scene about it.

text: {victim} found out something from your past and has been blackmailing you for months.
gossip: {victim} had something on {self}. {self} looked scared of {victim} all evening.

text: With {victim} gone, you inherit the family's old property in Lonavala. You are badly short of money.
gossip: If anything happened to {victim}, {self} would get the family property.

text: Two years ago {victim} broke off your engagement a week before the ceremony and humiliated your whole family.
gossip: {victim} dumped {self} days before their engagement, years ago. {self} never got over it.

text: {victim} was about to get you fired. You found the email this morning.

text: {victim} stole credit for your work and was praised for it again tonight.

text: You found out tonight that {victim} has been having an affair with your partner.
gossip: There were whispers that {victim} was involved with {self}'s partner.

text: Years ago {victim} was driving the car that crippled your younger brother, and got away with it because of connections.
gossip: {self}'s brother was hurt in an accident, and people say {victim} was driving.

text: {victim} has a video of you that could destroy your reputation, and laughed about it tonight.

text: {victim} has always had everything you wanted: the attention, the love, the credit. Tonight {victim} mocked you for it.

text: {victim} filed a police complaint against you last month. The hearing is next week and you could go to jail.

text: Earlier today {victim} accused you of stealing a gold bangle, in front of everyone. You didn't do it.
gossip: {victim} accused {self} of stealing earlier today. Big drama.

text: {victim} was selling the house you grew up in, and you would be thrown out.

text: {victim} was trying to get the wedding called off, which would shame your family forever.

text: {victim} found out the gold you gave as a gift is fake and was going to tell both families tomorrow.

text: {victim} knew you bought the leaked end-sem paper and was going to report you to the dean.

text: In your first year {victim} ragged you so badly that you almost dropped out.

text: {victim} rigged the hostel election and beat you by eleven votes.
gossip: {self} lost the election to {victim} and kept saying it was rigged.

text: {victim} copied your research and was about to publish it under their own name.
gossip: {self} said {victim} stole their research.

text: {victim} had you quietly replaced on the next film. You heard it from the junior artists.

text: {victim} spread lies about you to the press that sank your last film.
gossip: {self} blames {victim} for the stories that sank their last film.

text: {victim} hasn't paid you for nine months and laughed when you asked.
gossip: {victim} owed {self} months of pay.

text: {victim} cut your equity when the company raised money and pushed you out of the company you built.

text: You put your parents' retirement savings into {victim}'s company, and you just found out the numbers are fake.

text: {victim} talked you into a crypto scheme that wiped out everything you had.
